headline: Zhipu AI surges into top 3; NVIDIA's free tier finds traction
summary: Zhipu AI's glm-5.2 jumped three ranks to claim the #3 spot with 7.9% token share, marking a notable 2.2-point gain in a single day. Meanwhile, NVIDIA's nemotron-3-ultra-550b:free vaulted six places to #10 with a 1.8-point daily bump. DeepSeek and Tencent hold their duopoly at the top, though both shed share overnight.
highlights: Zhipu AI (glm-5.2-20260616) climbs 3 ranks to #3 with 7.9% share (+2.2% in 1d)
NVIDIA's nemotron-3-ultra-550b:free jumps 6 spots to #10 (+1.8% daily)
Anthropic's claude-4.7-opus surges 17 ranks to #18 (+0.8% in 1d)
Google debuts gemini-3.7-flash at #22 (1.0% share); Qwen and Google also enter top 51
Three models exit: Qwen's qwen3.6-35b, InclusionAI's ling-2.6-flash, Google's gemini-3.5-flash-lite
DeepSeek provider share: 24.9% (−1.7% daily); Anthropic gains to 8.2% (+0.9%)
